name: Nagasawa Asami
source:
A teacher who is strict with her students and a bit hysterical. Although she is married, things are not going well with her husband, and she is sexually frustrated.

They had one child, but lost him to illness at an early age.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/onnakyoushi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
